frozenBefore: fetching the documents and any further extraction change; extractor hashes in extractor-freeze-untouched.sha256 (Phase268 final extractor, commit 797d6f2)
selection: documents chosen by web search before access, from publishers never used by PEE for test values: the CHOICE (AU) air fryer vs oven energy article and the Consumer NZ air fryer vs oven article; plus at most 2 further pages they link to that report original measurements
gold: annotated by reading the transient bytes BEFORE the extractor is run on them; each tester-reported measurement with value, unit, measurand, subject (product or appliance class) and conditions
negativeControls: every number in the documents that is a rated power, food quantity, recipe temperature or time setting, tariff or cost, publisher score, unrelated model mention or another product's value is a negative control: extracting it is a false positive

metrics.precision: extracted leads matching a gold measurement / all extracted leads
metrics.attribution: measured separately: for each matching lead, is the subject association correct (exact product, class-level, or correctly unresolved)
metrics.conditions: share of matching leads whose condition codes agree with gold

rule: first run committed unchanged; any later fix is reported as tuned on these documents
